content: केदारः .²1 A field under water; meadow; केदारेभ्यस्त्वपोऽगृह्णन्कर्षका दृढसेतुभिः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 20. 41</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 38</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">44</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> the play on words in the <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> के दारपोषणरताः? and the reply is केदारपोषणरताः. .²2 A basin for water round the root of a tree. .²3 A mountain. .²4 A particular mountain forming part of the Himālayas (modern Kedār). .²5 A form of Śiva. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a Rāga (in music).
